visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling slider of teaser cards (news, references)
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1 / 2 / 3 cards visible (mobile / tablet / desktop), scroll-snap track
visualCharacteristics.controls: prev/next arrows and per-card indicators below the track
visualCharacteristics.notes: used in a dark section (section style 'dark'); CTA buttons align at card bottom

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (optionally linked); cell 2: eyebrow paragraph (date or label), linked heading, excerpt paragraph, CTA link (bold = primary button)

usage: 'Aktuelles' news and references slider on the homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use when more teaser cards exist than fit in one row. For a static grid of cards use cards-teaser; for a full-bleed rotating stage use carousel-stage.
